title: Ashok Kumar Maurya v. Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pankaj Mithal and Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed; bill correction relegated to Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.
headnote: The High Court declined writ interference with a District Consumer Forum execution order recording that an earlier complaint order had been implemented, holding that the remedy was an appeal to the State Forum. Challenge to an electricity bill of Rs. 60,329 was relegated to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Discretionary jurisdiction was not exercised; the writ was dismissed with that observation.
facts: The petitioner, a consumer of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., invoked writ jurisdiction to quash the 31 October 2018 order of the District Consumer Redressal Forum, Kaushambi, in Execution Case No. 5 of 2018, which recorded that the Forum's order in Complaint Case No. 52 of 2016 had been implemented. He also challenged an electricity bill of Rs. 60,329 and sought restoration of his electricity connection.

holding_units.holding: Correction of an electricity bill, if any, is to be considered by the Executive Engineer in accordance with Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the High Court will not examine the bill or restore supply in writ jurisdiction where that statutory route is available.
